verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence says a user can add or connect external MCP servers to Muse. Muse can connect first-party apps and write its own custom connectors for services with APIs or CLIs, but that is a related feature, not plugging in MCP servers. The probe finding is about Muse not exposing an MCP server surface (the server role), so it says nothing about MCP client support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
